task: Rework tasks/ozon-module-20260824/ARCH.md in place using the binding owner verdict tasks/ozon-module-20260824/S0_PRODUCT_VERDICT.md. Reuse-first is the default and a hard contract, not a preference. The target architecture must make the existing FBS flow marketplace-agnostic and add Ozon through adapters/capabilities plus only Ozon-specific fields, statuses, labels, packages or actions inside the existing queue/workspace. Ozon FBO must extend the existing marketplace shipment document/process in FfSuppliesShipmentsPage and its existing tabs/zones rather than introduce a separate Ozon FBO section or workspace. Ozon catalog mapping and account connection must extend the existing product catalog and seller settings surfaces rather than create Ozon-only catalog/connection routes. Ozon returns must enter the existing return/inbound document and physical acceptance flow, using conditional Ozon identifiers/quarantine steps rather than a standalone returns module. Preserve current WB observable behavior as a regression contract. Decide the minimal data and backend evolution needed for multi-line Ozon postings without forcing a new operator flow: compare additive line/package children and adapter-backed projection into current FBS work items versus other options, then select the smallest safe design. Remove every standalone `/app/ff/ozon/*` screen/route, separate FBO workspace and redundant navigation concept from the accepted architecture and prototype contract. A new screen, tab, document, workspace, route or operator step is forbidden unless you write concrete incompatibility evidence, show why adapter/capability/additional field/filter/conditional state cannot solve it, and scope the exception; after this owner verdict the expected result is zero new top-level UI routes. Produce an exact replacement prototype contract that modifies only bounded zones of the existing FBS queue/workspace, marketplace shipments document, product catalog and seller settings, plus the existing returns/inbound flow. Also create tasks/ozon-module-20260824/REUSE_MAP.json as valid structured evidence with `policy: reuse_first`, a row for every user-visible Ozon requirement, and fields `requirement_id`, `existing_surface`, `existing_route`, `minimal_delta`, `ozon_necessity`, `reuse_mechanism`, `new_surface_required`, `incompatibility_evidence`, `allowed_files`, `forbidden_scope`. `new_surface_required` must be false unless the strict exception proof is complete. Define a future CI gate that compares touched routes/screens/files to this map and fails on an unmapped new surface. Update vertical slices so their sum still delivers full Ozon FBS, FBO, catalog/connection, labels/documents, statuses, returns, reconciliation and account isolation without parallel UI. Ask the owner zero questions; use safe fallbacks for external capability unknowns. Do not write production or prototype code.
why_now: The owner rejected the standalone Ozon prototype because it duplicated existing WMS FBS and shipment/FBO processes, so the architecture must be rewritten around a hard, machine-checkable reuse-first contract before any replacement prototype or implementation.
